concept: Expand this into the complete DocMind app while preserving its editorial research-workspace direction. Include: 1) secure Groq API-key onboarding with clear privacy reassurance and link to obtain a key; 2) empty workspace with prominent PDF upload/drop target and concise workflow guidance; 3) active PDF conversation with multi-document switching, chat modes, summary and sources toggles, clear/export actions, grounded answer citations, follow-up prompts, indexing/loading states, and persistent composer; 4) responsive mobile adaptation where the document library becomes a drawer and secondary controls collapse cleanly. Use only capabilities that exist in the current product. Keep accessible contrast, visible focus, 44px targets, and reduced-motion-safe transitions.
